description: Answers who this connection belongs to, what it may do (read, or read and propose changes), how much of its rate allowance is left, whether a hosted copy exists and when it was last pushed, how many proposals are waiting for the owner's app, which ones it could not apply and why (failed_to_apply), and where the schemas live. One call, so it also shows whether the connection can read and write.
name: whoami
title: Who am I here
